floorplan_why: gather v4 direct leaf, 190.08 x 164.16 (slot grid unchanged).  The leaf carries ONLY its own traffic: li 276 b (4 lanes) on the E face, co 212 + st 2 + rso on S, ck + rs on N (494 signal pins; v3 3,423).  8 arrays as two abutted N-S stacks (pins W / E only) at y 22.8..138.5, pushed to the face WITHOUT pins so a 68.5-um band behind the li face is free of macros: the 276 lane bits reach the 4 roots without crossing an array (v3: 1,932 W-E crossings through 44 um of M2/M4 beside 116-um macro walls -> GRT-0116 on g2 and g3).  Cut: li 276 b over the 164-um face = 1.7 b/um vs ~25 M2+M4 tracks/um; results 214 b leave S over 190 um.  Std ~8.4k um2 + arrays 8.7k um2 in 29.7k um2 core = 0.575.
